description: A Minecraft mod that backs up your server world to AWS S3

mods.name: S3 Backup Mod
mods.description: Save your precious world files to S3 cloud storage!

releases.notes:
v1.1.0

* Better optimized multipart uploading to allow for larger world sizes to be uploaded quicker
* Added configurable options for multipart settings (Best to leave as default and lower if need be.)
* Added new option to change the name for the world backup
* Fixed bug where multipart uploads weren't deleting locally
